sources.cite: ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI, Computer Science Curricula 2023 (CS2023), knowledge areas (SEC: Security)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of the report's first part: 17 knowledge areas, among them SEC: Security; the fetch reached the table of contents, not the topic lists. The CMPCBS course cites CS2023 and its unit's open textbooks (dated 2026-11-11, REQ-245). The case's decision: a departed employee's account still active is an access control failure; disable it, review what it did, and fix the deprovisioning process so the control works for every leaver.

sources.cite: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (release 5.2.0), AC-2 Account Management and AC-2(3) Disable Accounts
sources.note: Read 2026-11-14 through a summarizing fetch of the csf.tools mirror of the 5.2.0 catalog, not NIST's own page. Relevant text: create, enable, modify, disable and remove accounts in accordance with policy; notify account managers 'when accounts are no longer required' and when 'users are terminated or transferred'; review accounts at a defined frequency; AC-2(3) 'Disable accounts within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] when the accounts' are no longer associated with a user. A federal control catalog used as good practice, not a rule for the fictional company.
